decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to put constant pressure on the opponent by playing low-cost aggressive creatures and spells. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Cast Down and Galvanic Blast while also drawing cards with Ichor Wellspring and Nihil Spellbomb. The deck also utilizes sacrifice synergies with cards like Makeshift Munitions and Reckoner's Bargain to deal additional damage. Overall, the deck focuses on outpacing the opponent and overwhelming them with quick, efficient threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently control the board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By combining disruptive spells like Counterspell and Sleep of the Dead with card draw and creature buffs, the deck aims to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Cryptic Serpent and Murmuring Mystic, along with card selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder, allows the deck to adapt to different situations and outpace opponents in the early game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and disrupting their hand with cards like Duress. With a mix of removal spells, card draw, and Faerie creatures to create tempo advantage, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Thorn of the Black Rose provides an additional win condition by generating card advantage, while the mana base allows for smooth mana curve and options for graveyard hate with Bojuka Bog.

The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent through a combination of low-cost creatures with aggressive abilities like Voldaren Epicure and Sneaky Snacker, along with direct burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast. The deck also includes card draw and damage dealing synergy cards like Faithless Looting and Guttersnipe to maintain momentum. The goal is to efficiently chip away at the opponent's life total while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Highway Robbery and Grab the Prize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal direct damage to the opponent's life total through a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy that aims to end the game as quickly as possible. By utilizing efficient creatures and direct damage spells, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize or mount a defense.

The deck is designed to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a combination of direct burn spells and creature attacks. Cards like Guttersnipe and Sneaky Snacker provide additional damage each time a spell is cast, while Fiery Temper and Lightning Bolt can remove enemy creatures or target the opponent directly. Faithless Looting helps with card selection and Grab the Prize provides additional resources. With a low mana curve and a focus on aggression, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of low-cost, efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing counterspells and bounce effects, the deck aims to maintain control of the board while continuously applying pressure with creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells to ensure a steady stream of threats. Overall, this Mono Blue Aggro deck seeks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of aggression and control.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the Urzatron lands to generate a large amount of colorless mana. This mana is then used to cast powerful spells such as Malevolent Rumble and Nyxborn Hydra, as well as to activate abilities like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map to search for key cards. The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and overwhelming the opponent with big creatures and disruptive spells, creating a strong board presence and outpacing the opponent's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal while generating card advantage with Ephemerate and Mulldrifter. Augur of Bolas helps with finding key spells, while Archaeomancer allows for recurring important instants and sorceries. The deck also includes some snow lands to support Skred as removal. Murmuring Mystic provides a win condition by generating bird tokens, and Fanged Flames can act as a finisher. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through careful spell selection and resource management.

The main focus of the deck is to establish early board presence with cheap creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Brinebarrow Intruder, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell. Moon-Circuit Hacker and Snap provide tempo advantage, allowing for efficient creature removal and card advantage. Ninja of the Deep Hours provides additional card draw and evasion, while Faerie Seer and Of One Mind help maintain card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a flurry of flying creatures and efficient spells while maintaining control of the game.

The key concept of this deck is to take advantage of the affinity mechanic to quickly and efficiently play artifacts for cheap in order to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards that benefit from having artifacts in play, such as Thoughtcast and Myr Enforcer, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and speed up its game plan. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Blast to deal with opposing threats and continue applying pressure.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game using powerful blue cards and tempo plays, while also utilizing the graveyard as a resource with cards like Thought Scour and Mental Note. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells, while also presenting threats like Tolarian Terror and Cryptic Serpent to apply pressure. The inclusion of card selection spells like Ponder and Brainstorm helps ensure the deck runs smoothly, while cards like Lórien Revealed and Sleep of the Dead provide additional utility and value.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of Gates to generate mana and support aggressive creatures. The strategy involves using removal spells like Journey to Nowhere and Lightning Bolt to clear threats, while Prismatic Strands provides protection against combat damage. Outlaw Medic and Basilisk Gate provide recurring life gain and creature removal, allowing the player to outlast their opponent. The deck also utilizes creatures like Sacred Cat and Sneaky Snacker to apply pressure and maintain board presence. Ultimately, the goal is to control the game through a combination of removal, creature threats, and mana acceleration.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and using a combination of sacrifice effects and direct damage spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. The key strategy is to amass a large number of artifacts to enable powerful synergy with cards like Myr Enforcer and Thoughtcast, while using cards like Galvanic Blast and Krark-Clan Shaman to maintain tempo and aggression. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruptive plays, while leveraging its unique mix of artifacts to dictate the pace of the game.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to ramp up quickly with cards like Arbor Elf, Utopia Sprawl, and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss to cast big threats like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter. Writhing Chrysalis, Eldrazi Repurposer, and Thermokarst help with removal and disruption, while cards like Wild Growth and Bonder's Ornament provide additional value and card draw. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and large creatures, while also disrupting their mana base with cards like Mountain and Structural Distortion.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost creatures and disruptive spells while maintaining card advantage and tempo. By utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets, Tolarian Terror, and Cryptic Serpent, the deck aims to apply pressure early and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. Counterspells and other disruption spells like Dispel and Spell Pierce help control the board and protect the deck's creatures, allowing for a fast and efficient aggro strategy.
